UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user trading journal settings, initial capital, and sync metadata.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user owning this profile.

priceStaleThresholdSec.description: Maximum age of price data in seconds before considered expired.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether signal touch notifications are enabled.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision number for conflict detection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Mentor.title: Mentor
Mentor.description: Represents a crypto trading signal mentor with a stable unique ID.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

handleOrChannel.description: Optional Telegram/Discord/X handle or channel name.

specialty.description: Optional trading style or market specialty.

isDeleted.description: Tombstone flag for synchronized soft deletion.

revision.description: Revision counter for sync conflict resolution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when mentor was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when mentor was last updated.

TradingSignal.title: TradingSignal
TradingSignal.description: Represents a crypto trading signal from a mentor with Entry, TP, and SL levels.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user owning this signal.

mentorId.description: Stable ID of the mentor who issued the signal.

mentorName.description: Display name snapshot of the mentor.

pair.description: Crypto trading pair such as BTC/USDT.

signalTimestampMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the signal was issued.

entryPrices.description: Ordered list of Entry price levels (1 to 10 levels).

reachedEntryIndices.description: List of 0-based entry level indices that have been touched.

missedEntryIndices.description: List of 0-based entry level indices marked TIDAK TERCAPAI after SL hit.

tpPrices.description: Ordered list of Take Profit price levels (1 to 10 levels).

reachedTpIndices.description: List of 0-based TP level indices that have been touched.

slHit.description: Whether the Stop Loss level has been touched.

returnedToEntry.description: Whether price returned to Entry after an Entry touch before TP.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the signal.

isConservativeEstimation.description: Whether outcome used conservative SL-first estimation after a data gap.

priceSource.description: Configured primary price source for monitoring.

outcomeSource.description: Price source that confirmed the final outcome.

hasSourceConflict.description: Whether Binance and CoinGecko reported conflicting level touches.

lastCheckedPrice.description: Last verified market price for this pair.

lastCheckedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when price was last verified.

completedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the signal reached a final outcome.

isDeleted.description: Tombstone flag for synchronized soft deletion.

revision.description: Revision number for multi-device conflict detection.

lastOperationId.description: Idempotency operation key for the latest mutation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when signal was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when signal was last updated.

SignalEvent.title: SignalEvent
SignalEvent.description: Immutable or status-tracked timeline event for a trading signal.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

signalId.description: The ID of the parent TradingSignal.

eventType.description: Type of signal lifecycle or price event.

levelIndex.description: 0-based index of Entry or TP level, or -1 if not applicable.

price.description: Market price at which the event occurred.

priceSource.description: Source of the price or action that triggered the event.

eventTimestampMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the event was recorded.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique operation/event key preventing duplicate events and notifications.

notificationStatus.description: Delivery status of the local notification for this event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was persisted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event was last updated.

RealizedTrade.title: RealizedTrade
RealizedTrade.description: Actual closed trading position recorded by the user for realized P/L and balance calculation.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

signalId.description: Optional linked signal ID (empty string if standalone).

feeUsdt.description: Total exchange fees paid in USDT.

realizedPnlUsdt.description: Net realized profit or loss in USDT after fees.

closedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the position was closed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when trade record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when trade record was updated.

/users/{userId}/signals/{signalId}.description: Crypto trading signals logged by the user.

/users/{userId}/signal_events/{eventId}.description: Timeline events and level touches for the user's signals.

/users/{userId}/realized_trades/{tradeId.description: Actual realized trades logged by the user for real balance and P/L calculation.
